_readme: Ground truth for the AudioLearner question-generation evaluation (Proposal 3.5.1).
For each lesson note, `coreConcepts` lists the facts a teacher would expect a
short revision quiz to test. They were chosen by reading each note as a teacher
would - BEFORE looking at what the generator produces - so that a concept the
generator structurally cannot reach still counts against recall. That is the
point: the ground truth must be able to fail the system.
Five concepts per note matches the generator's 5-question cap, so recall asks a
fair question: 'do the five questions it produces cover the five things that
matter?' rather than penalising it for a length limit.
`anchors` are distinctive phrases; a concept counts as COVERED when any anchor
appears in a generated question's text or its correct answer (case-insensitive).

coreConcepts.concept: Place value is the position of a digit in a number
If the digit to the right is 5 or more, round up
Addends are the numbers being added
Under BODMAS, addition and subtraction are done from left to right
A number is divisible by 2 if its last digit is even
Living things are things that are alive
Non-living things are things that are not alive
MRS GREN summarises the characteristics of living things
Living things can move by themselves; non-living things cannot
Living things reproduce and produce young ones
Food is anything we eat or drink that gives energy, helps growth and keeps us healthy
Carbohydrates are energy-giving foods
Proteins are body-building foods
A balanced diet contains all six classes of food in the right amounts
Kwashiorkor is caused by lack of protein
Water is a colourless, tasteless and odourless liquid
Evaporation is the change from liquid water to water vapour
Condensation is the change from water vapour to liquid water
Safe water is free from germs and dirt and is good for drinking
Boiling is the commonest method of making water safe at home
Digestion is the process of breaking food into small particles the body can absorb
The alimentary canal runs from the mouth to the anus
Incisors are the front teeth used for cutting and biting
Bile is made by the liver and breaks fat into small droplets
The small intestine is where most digestion and absorption take place
Weather is the condition of the atmosphere at a particular time
Climate is the average weather condition over a long time
A rain gauge measures the amount of rainfall
A thermometer measures temperature
Relief rainfall forms when moist air is forced to rise over a mountain
Physical features are natural things found on the earth's surface
Mount Rwenzori is the highest mountain in Uganda
Lake Victoria is the largest lake in Uganda and Africa
River Nile is the longest river in Africa and starts from Lake Victoria
A rift valley forms when land sinks between two faults
A fraction is a number that represents a part of a whole
The numerator is the number written above the line
The denominator is the number written below the line
A proper fraction has a numerator smaller than its denominator
Equivalent fractions have the same value but different numbers
A noun names a person, place, animal or thing
A pronoun is used in place of a noun
A verb shows an action or a state of being
An adjective describes a noun or pronoun
An adverb describes a verb, adjective or another adverb
Personal hygiene is keeping our bodies and clothes clean to stay healthy
A germ is a very small living thing that causes disease
Malaria is spread by the female anopheles mosquito
Cholera is caused by drinking water containing germs
Immunisation is giving a vaccine to protect against disease
